description: The 'plugins_and_their_code_env' dataset provides comprehensive information about various plugins and their associated code environments. It includes details such as the name and size of the code environment, deployment mode, and the projects where these environments are utilized. This dataset is particularly useful for managing and analyzing the deployment and usage of plugins within different projects. It helps in understanding the distribution and frequency of plugin usage, which can be critical for resource allocation and optimization. The dataset also includes URLs for direct access to the code environments, making it easier for users to navigate and manage these resources. Additionally, it provides unique identifiers for each plugin, ensuring precise tracking and management. This dataset is valuable for developers, project managers, and IT administrators who need to monitor and optimize the use of plugins and code environments in their systems.
shortDesc: Dataset of plugins and their code environments, including deployment and usage details.

columns.name: code_env_name
columns.comment: Name of the code environment, identifies environment.

columns.name: size_in_MB
columns.comment: Size of environment in megabytes, storage size.

columns.name: projectKeys_where_code_env_used
columns.comment: Projects using this environment, project identifiers.

columns.name: total_instances_of_code_env
columns.comment: Number of instances of the environment, usage count.

columns.name: url
columns.comment: URL to access the code environment, direct link.

columns.name: plugin_id
columns.comment: Unique identifier for each plugin, key for tracking.

columns.name: plugin_used_in_projectkeys
columns.comment: List of project keys where the plugin is used.

columns.name: plugin_total_usages
columns.comment: Number of times the plugin has been used, usage metric.

columns.name: plugin_is_built_in_plugin
columns.comment: Indicates if the plugin is built-in, boolean value.
